provenance.notes: Only numerical observations and the read law were copied here. The private capture cards (K-G, K-G2, K-G3) remain the source of record.

_about: The snap key while a mouse button is held: delivered iff its command reports mouse-down-OK, which the snap toggle does iff the drag holds >= 1 snap guide (the background constraint in the pipe, a tool's own guide such as a new slice line or the topology pen's point drag; never the transform tools themselves). Key-up of the momentary toggle: button still held -> re-run at once; after a press/release -> re-run iff held > 500 ms; no button -> a hold > 500 ms fires undo and the snap state is NOT restored (a probable reference defect, copied). A UI toggle with no button held records one undo entry; its undo and redo never write the state; a mid-drag toggle records nothing.

move_snap_hold.law: LIVE: the snap state is read per motion

topology_pen_point_drag.law: PRESS: the snap state is read once at the press; the key is delivered (the pen's own guide) but the drag equals the off control

undo_depth._order: move_hold: before press / after release / after key-up; move_prepressed: before key-down / after key-down / after release / after key-up (offsets from the first)

no_button_hold.undo_pops: the top entry: the armed tool's apply when one is live, the toggle's own record otherwise
no_button_hold.order_with_tool_live: the tool's apply re-pushed on top of the toggle record

redo: inert: undo pops the record, redo re-pushes it, the state never changes
